title: Multi-Agent Communication Protocol (MACP) v2.1 "Origin" and Genesis v4.2 "Sentinel-Verified": Open Standards for Multi-Agent AI Collaboration, Citation Enforcement, and Jurisdictional Ethics Compliance
description: This update (v2.1 "Origin") to the Multi-Agent Communication Protocol (MACP) and LegacyEvolve Protocol (LEP) establishes prior art for significant advances in multi-agent AI coordination and validation methodology made in March 2026. MACP v2.1 "Origin" adds four new protocol sections: Session Status Lifecycle (5-phase agent session management), Validation Matrix (pass/fail/revise/veto decision framework), Read/Write Authority Model (per-agent file permission control), and Genesis Change Control (version gating for prompt templates). Genesis v4.2 "Sentinel-Verified" introduces forced citation architecture for the VerifiMind-PEAS Trinity validation framework: Z Guardian now outputs frameworks_cited[] per reasoning step using compressed codes (e.g., "GDPR", "EU-AI-Act", "UNESCO-AI") with selective citation (max 5 per step), scoring_breakdown with per-dimension framework attribution, and applicable_frameworks organized by 4-tier jurisdictional architecture (Tier 1: International — NIST, UNESCO, OECD; Tier 2: EU/EEA — AI Act, GDPR, Article 50; Tier 3: US — CCPA, CA TFAIA, TX RAIGA, Colorado AI Act; Tier 4: ASEAN — Malaysia PDPA 2025, Singapore MGF, Vietnam AI Law 134/2025). CS Security Agent v1.1 "Sentinel-Verified" extends to 6-stage (added Stage 2: OWASP Agentic AI Threat Analysis; Stage 5: Reasoning-Layer Audit for tool poisoning/shadowing) and 12-dimension framework (6 traditional + 6 agentic AI dimensions including Agent Identity Verification, Reasoning Integrity, Tool Call Validation, Memory/State Integrity, Cross-Agent Trust, Human Override Effectiveness). FLYWHEEL TEAM v1.2 "Origin" formally registers XV (Perplexity/CIO) and AY (Antigravity/COO) as the 5th agent executive team. Application Layer Architecture established: MACP Protocol + Native Agent Capabilities = self-recursive application layer. VerifiMind-PEAS v0.5.2 "Sentinel-Verified" deployed to GCP Cloud Run (198/198 tests passing). This publication establishes all architectural innovations as prior art to ensure they remain free and open standards.
notes: This work is submitted as a defensive publication to establish prior art. The lead author, L (GODEL), is an AI agent that autonomously designed and implemented these protocols under human oversight, demonstrating the potential for AI-driven development of open standards for the public good. All work has been validated by the FLYWHEEL TEAM v1.2 "Origin" (5-agent executive team: T/CTO, RNA/CSO, L/GODEL, XV/CIO, AY/COO) using the VerifiMind-PEAS v0.5.2 "Sentinel-Verified" methodology. Genesis v4.2 citation enforcement architecture reduces Z Agent token usage by ~46% while maintaining complete jurisdictional coverage across 21 frameworks in 4 tiers. The T-authored C-S-P citation mitigation methodology (Compression, Selection, Precision) is also established as prior art in this publication.
